description: India GST input tax credit check. Matches the supplier invoices in GSTR-2B against the purchase register from the books (Tally, Zoho Books, Busy, QuickBooks or any list) and sorts every invoice into: matched, amount mismatch, entered twice (duplicate bills), possible match (invoice number or GSTIN written differently), in books but not in GSTR-2B (credit at risk), in GSTR-2B but not in books. A separate checker re-derives the totals, and the result comes with a receipt signed by Nityaflow. Invoices are processed in memory and not stored. It never files or accepts anything on the GST portal.

books.description: Purchase register from the books: a list of invoices like {gstin, invoice, date, name, taxable, igst, cgst, sgst, cess, value}. Use the supplier's bill number, not the voucher number.

client.description: Client or business name, for the receipt.

gstr2b.description: GSTR-2B: either the JSON file downloaded from the GST portal, or a list of invoices like {gstin, invoice, date, taxable, igst, cgst, sgst, cess}.

tolerance.description: Allowed difference in rupees before amounts count as different. Default 1.

name: gst_credit_match
title: Match GSTR-2B with the purchase register
